Forest Village Rules

Forest animals build a village from late winter to winter. Whoever has the most points when everyone is done wins; alone you play for a target score.

The rules

Resources and the forest
There are four resources: wood, resin, pebbles and berries. Each player starts with 2 squirrels. A squirrel sent to a field of the forest brings what is written there: Woodpile 3 wood, Resin Fir 2 resin, Pebble Brook 1 pebble, Berry Slope 2 berries, Forest Path 2 wood and 1 berry, Clearing 1 pebble and 1 berry. These six fields take only one squirrel at a time. Old Oak (1 wood and 2 cards) and Market (3 cards) have room for all.
A turn
On your turn you do one thing: send a free squirrel into the forest, or build one card, or – when all your squirrels are out – change the season. Then it is the next player's turn. Each player moves through the seasons at their own pace.
Buildings and animals
You build cards from your hand or from the meadow, the 8 open cards in the middle; a card taken from the meadow is replaced at once. Building costs the resources shown on the card. There are 25 buildings and 25 animals, and every animal belongs to one building: if that building stands in your village and has no animal yet, the animal moves in for free. Some cards give resources or cards once when built; production cards give their goods when built and again in spring and autumn. At most 15 cards fit into a village and 8 into your hand; a card drawn into a full hand is lost.
Seasons
When all your squirrels are out, you may change the season: the squirrels come back, then spring brings 1 more squirrel, summer 2 cards, autumn 2 more squirrels. In spring and autumn every production card of your village gives its goods again. Winter is the last season: when you can or want to do nothing more, tap Done for this game.
End and points
The game ends when everyone is done with winter. Points come from the cards in your village, 2 points for every pair (a building with its animal), the end bonuses of some cards and the task card: one task lies open each game, and everyone who fulfils it at the end gets its points. Players who start later get more cards at the start (5, 6, 7 and 8).
Alone
With 1 player you play the same rules and win if you have at least 45 points at the end.
Playing
Tap a free field of the forest to send a squirrel there. Tap a card in your hand or on the meadow to read it, then Build; cards you cannot pay for now say so. The list below shows the last moves, including the computer's. Against the computer: Easy often plays at random, Medium builds what looks best now, Hard also plans for the animals and the end. On one device the hand is covered between turns.

Example

You pay 2 wood and 1 pebble for the Bakery. It gives you 2 berries at once and again in spring and autumn. Later the Hedgehog moves in for free, because its Bakery stands in your village: 2 points for the Bakery, 1 for the Hedgehog and 2 for the pair.
